description: A sleek white and blue electronic toy containing a virtual pet that can be raised and battled. This is super rare! Displayed on the screen is an digital egg! Maybe raising this will fill the void inside... Press 'a' to activate.

use_action.description: There are many different eggs to choose from! ♥
